long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Brooklyn in 1943, David Geffen entered entertainment through the William Morris Agency mailroom and rose to become a talent agent. He co-founded Asylum Records in 1971, founded Geffen Records in 1980 and expanded into film before joining Steven Spielberg and Jeffrey Katzenberg to create DreamWorks SKG in 1994. Those music and movie ventures underpin the self-made fortune Forbes attributes to him.

Geffen later retired from entertainment and concentrated on philanthropy and collecting art. His gifts include major support for UCLA, tuition-free study at Yale’s drama school and cultural institutions in Los Angeles and New York. Forbes also identifies him as the owner of Rising Sun; he first bought a half-interest from Larry Ellison and acquired the remaining share in 2010, establishing a well-documented long-term yachting connection.
